cues.text:
I searched the distance
I watched the sky

I waited for You
To pass me by

But in the silence
I finally knew

The breath in my lungs
Was delivered by You

Not far away
Not somewhere above

You have been here
You have been enough

Closer than the air around me
Nearer than my heartbeat

You are here
You are here

Breathe life into the silence
Wake what sleeps inside me

By Your Holy Spirit
Break chains; set me free.

Where hope grew quiet
Where faith grew thin

You never left me
You stayed within

No empty distance
No endless sea

Could ever carry
Your love from me

Before I called
You knew my name

Before I reach
Your hand remains

Closer than the air around me
Nearer than my heartbeat

You are here
You are here

Breathe life into the silence
Wake what sleeps inside me

By Your Holy Spirit
Break chains; set me free.

You are not far
You are not gone

You are here
In every breath
In every dawn

You are here
Breathe again

Breathe again
What was dry

Let it live
What was still
Let it rise

By Your Spirit
Breathe again
Breathe again

Closer than the air around me
Nearer than my heartbeat

You are here
You are here

Breathe life into the silence
Wake what sleeps inside me

By Your Holy Spirit
Break chains; set me free.

In You I live
In You I move

Every breath
Belongs to You
To You ...
